articles.title: An Empirical Analysis of Cross-OS Portability Issues in Python Projects
articles.summary: While Python is designed as a cross-platform language, real-world applications encounter portability failures when deployed across different operating systems. We present the first large-scale empirical study of cross-OS portability issues in Python, analyzing 2,042 open-source repositories using two complementary approaches: systematic cross-OS test reexecution and manual analysis of GitHub issues.
